MAC - INSTALL "EDGE r1" on botfix r1.1 (executor 725b19ff -> 9f8bcb8c)   PRIVATE - server address inside
=========================================================================================================
What it changes (each has its own switch below):
  1. EARLY EXIT - about 2 minutes after the fill, if the trade is 10+ pts against you and was never +3, it is closed
     at market (about -$60) instead of waiting for the full stop. The 30 / 50-pt stops do not move.
  2. RUNNER BY SESSION - Asia and London: all 3 contracts out at TP1 (+15). NY: 2 out at TP1, the runner's stop goes
     to entry +2 and its target is 2 x the 15-minute ATR; flat by the session close. A TP1 win can never become a loss.
Unchanged: entries, size 3, stop distances, TP1 +15, the no-progress exit, morning hold, news pause, safe exits, alerts.
Evidence: about 4-6 days of your live trades (early exit +$663 on 9 trades; NY runner +$1,240 on 18 trades, 3 big ones
carry most of it). 292 tests pass, boots to LIVE, install + rollback dry-run clean. No replays were run.
MacDot / MacMillionz review is pending.

Be FLAT in TopstepX. Put MacBot-edge-r1.zip in Downloads, open PowerShell:

1) Check the file:
  cd $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads
  Get-FileHash .\MacBot-edge-r1.zip
     (must start with 67DFED7E)

2) Copy it up and unpack:
  scp .\MacBot-edge-r1.zip root@<server>:/root/
  ssh root@<server> "mkdir -p /root/edge1 && cd /root/edge1 && python3 -m zipfile -e /root/MacBot-edge-r1.zip . && ls MacBot-edge-r1"

3) Install (type YES when asked):
  ssh -t root@<server> "cd /root/edge1/MacBot-edge-r1 && MACBOT_DIR=/opt/mac-bot bash install-edge.sh tree"
     You want at the end: "session stamp ... (executor 9f8bcb8c" and "DONE". Keep the rollback line it prints.
     (No phone-server restart is needed this time.)

4) Check (wait 2 min):
  ssh root@<server> "journalctl -u mac-bot-live --since '-5 min' --no-pager | grep -E 'session stamp|\[eae\]|\[runner\]|\[exits\]|\[health\]|Entering live loop|FATAL|ERROR' | tail -12"
     You want: "executor 9f8bcb8c", "[eae] early adverse exit: ON", "[runner] session runner: asia all contracts out at TP1 ...
     ny runner stop entry +2, TP2 2 x ATR15", "Entering live loop". No FATAL / ERROR lines.

SWITCHES (each restarts the bot - be flat):
 Early exit -> LOG ONLY (records what it would do, changes no trade):
  ssh root@<server> "echo  | base64 -d | bash"
 Early exit -> ON again:
  ssh root@<server> "echo  | base64 -d | bash"
 Runner -> the OLD rule in every session (2 off at TP1, runner stop +10, trail 10):
  ssh root@<server> "echo  | base64 -d | bash"
 Runner -> the NEW session rule again:
  ssh root@<server> "echo  | base64 -d | bash"

ROLLBACK to botfix r1.1 (flat first): run the "bash .../rollback-edge.sh ..." line step 3 printed, as
  ssh -t root@<server> "bash <BACKUP-FOLDER>/rollback-edge.sh <BACKUP-FOLDER>"
